purpose: Validate EMIR Refit UTI format (ISO 23897, 52 alphanumeric characters max), generating-party identity, and T+1 sharing timing: UTI must be shared with the other counterparty by 10:00 CET next business day (approximately 34-hour window). Caller supplies Unix timestamps. Catches late or malformed UTIs before Trade Repository submission. Feeds UPI validator (art-155).
